_guide: Wonders: sights worth seeing. Each one unlocks the first time you find a world that matches it, and shows on the
Ship page, under Achievements. (Solving a mystery gives a Wonder too: that's written in mysteries.json.)
One entry each: id (lowercase, never reused), ic (an emoji), name, desc (shown as a hint before you've seen it), when:
type ("Ocean"), rarity, star ("binary pair"), rings (true), moons, lifeLvl (0 to 6), temp (degrees C), hab (0 to 100),
water (percent), gravity (in g), weatherWords and biomeWords (single words from the weather or biomes, like "glass").
Numbers can be ">9" or "<0.3". Every key in when must match.

wonders.name: Rings over the sea
wonders.desc: Find an ocean world with rings.

wonders.name: A garden under rings
wonders.desc: Find a garden world with rings.

wonders.name: Rain made of glass
wonders.desc: Find a world where the rain is glass.

wonders.name: A sky full of moons
wonders.desc: Find a world with ten or more moons.

wonders.name: Someone is home
wonders.desc: Find a world with signs of intelligence.

wonders.name: Two suns setting
wonders.desc: Find a world with two suns.

wonders.name: A world with no sun
wonders.desc: Find a world drifting alone, with no star at all.

wonders.name: Diamonds everywhere
wonders.desc: Find a world with diamonds in its biomes.

wonders.name: Almost Earth
wonders.desc: Find a world at least 90% habitable.

wonders.name: The sunset that never ends
wonders.desc: Find a world where the sun never moves.

wonders.name: A star that blinks
wonders.desc: Find a world around a pulsar.

wonders.name: Light as a feather
wonders.desc: Find a world with gravity under a third of Earth's.

wonders.name: A world that sings
wonders.desc: Find a world with singing crystals.

wonders.name: Things that glow
wonders.desc: Find a world where something glows.

wonders.name: Ice under a blue giant
wonders.desc: Find a frozen world around a blue giant.

wonders.name: Something big in the water
wonders.desc: Find an ocean world with swimming creatures (or more).
